commands.title: Compatibility · iOS Simulator Renderer
commands.run: unset TOOLCHAINS; mv AemiSDR.xcworkspace "$RUNNER_TEMP/AemiSDR-navigation.xcworkspace"; xcodebuild -skipMacroValidation -skipPackagePluginValidation -scheme AemiSDR -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath "$RUNNER_TEMP/AemiSDR" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build; status=$?; mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/AemiSDR-navigation.xcworkspace" AemiSDR.xcworkspace; exit $status
